key_concepts: A suspension is a kind of mixture where visible particles can be seen with the naked eye
Suspension particles settle at the bottom when left undisturbed
Suspensions appear cloudy when two materials are mixed
Mixtures can be classified as solutions, suspensions, and colloids based on solubility
Tea leaves in hot water form a suspension
Flour in water forms a suspension and does not dissolve completely
Muddy water is an example of a suspension
Oil mixed with water forms a suspension
Suspensions are used in processing food, beverages, and medicine
A sugar and water mixture is not a suspension
